title: Hybrid-height bounds mix up the bottom and top of atmospheric layers
description: We sort the b coefficients into numerical order on their own. But a and b must describe the same physical interface together. Sorting only b pairs the bottom height term with the top terrain term.
example: Above the highest piControl terrain, reconstructed interfaces are displaced by up to 286 m and neighbouring layers overlap by up to 571 m. A calculation that integrates cloud over layer thickness can therefore be wrong even when the cloud values themselves are fine.
scientific_evidence: All 422 first-file headers show b bounds in ascending numeric order while height-coefficient bounds follow increasing altitude. For the first layer a=[0,49.9989] m but b=[0.9942963,1]; the physically paired b vertices should be [1,0.9942963]. Reversing each b pair agrees with the ESMValCore reference within numerical precision. With z=a+b×orog, the piControl maximum orography (5,499.87 m) gives interface errors up to 285.95 m and adjacent-layer overlaps up to 570.63 m. The existing lev_bnds formula_terms explicitly pairs these arrays, so the mismatch affects the encoded physical boundaries.
impact: Layer thicknesses and conservative vertical operations are wrong. Centre coefficients and raw cloud/pressure/CO₂ values are not shown to be wrong by this finding; calculations using only centres can be unaffected.
recommended_action: Preserve the common physical interface order of a and b. Remove independent np.sort on b_bnds, preserve lev_bnds formula_terms="a: lev_bnds b: b_bnds orog: orog", and validate reconstructed altitude continuity over ocean and high terrain. Do not sort one formula term just to satisfy a checker.
development_team_action: MOPPy: remove independent b-bound sorting and retain native a/b interface pairing. cc-plugin-wcrp 2.3.5 already accepts decreasing coefficients, so no new VAR012 checker issue is indicated. Existing unrelated CF advisory #662 remains. Publication team: replace the affected releases after physical-coordinate validation.
extent_statement: Complete file list within the identified release versions; numerical confirmation was sampled, not a scan of every value.
publication_action: No withdrawal, retraction, replacement or ESGF submission performed by this task.
validation: Fresh Gadi cl, cli, clw, pfull and model-level co23D preserve data, masks and coordinate centres. The sampled interface mismatch of up to 285.946 m and overlap of 570.625 m disappear; phalf remains unchanged. All 115 focused tests passed.
